title: Stress Relief & Relaxation

title: Enhanced Focus & Clarity

title: Emotional Healing
description: Rose Quartz and Unakite promote self-love, compassion, and emotional balance. They help heal past wounds and open the heart to new possibilities.

title: Protection & Grounding
description: Black Onyx and Tiger Eye create a protective shield against negative energies while keeping you grounded and centered in challenging situations.

title: Prosperity & Abundance
description: Green Jade and Pyrite attract wealth, success, and good fortune. They help manifest your goals and open doors to new opportunities.

title: Spiritual Growth

title: Physical Vitality
